entity_level_taxes.name: Corporation Business Tax minimum tax (CBT-100S)
entity_level_taxes.notes: NJ S corps pay only the minimum tax by NJ gross receipts: under $100,000 = $375; $100k-250k = $562; $250k-500k = $750; $500k-1M = $1,125; $1M+ = $1,500; $2,000 if in a group with payroll of $5M+. Since privilege periods beginning on/after Dec 22, 2022 a federal S corp can file as NJ S corp without a prior NJ election (needs Shareholder Jurisdictional Consent). 2025 instructions.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Pass-Through Business Alternative Income Tax (BAIT), elective, for partnerships and S corporations (referenced on CBT-100S line 11b). Rates not read on an official page today.

personal_exemption.notes: $1,000 per taxpayer/spouse; other exemptions $1,500 (dependents) and $6,000 categories per NJ-1040-ES worksheet. No standard deduction. No return required if gross income is $10,000 or less (single) / $20,000 or less (MFJ).

unemployment_2026.notes: New employer UI rate 2.6825% (FY July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027), plus employer WF/SWF 0.1175% and DI 0.50%. Wage base up from $43,300 (2025).

notable: LLC formation fee is $100 on the current DORES fee schedule (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/revenue/fees.shtml)
S corps pay a gross-receipts minimum tax ($375 to $1,500) even with no NJ income tax at entity level (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/pdf/current/cbt/cbt100sins.pdf)
No standard deduction; brackets not indexed; top rate 10.75% over $1M (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/pdf/current/1040esi.pdf)
